info.name: Bems Farms Platform Master API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for Bems Farms backend encompassing 628 endpoints across Customer E-commerce, Driver Mobile & Logistics, Admin Operations, ERP, Finance, POS, AI, and Telemetry.

### Authentication
- Authenticate via 'POST /api/auth/login' (Customer/Admin) or 'POST /api/driver/auth/login' (Driver).
- The collection script automatically extracts and persists the Bearer token into the {{token}} environment variable.
- All authenticated requests inherit Bearer authentication automatically.
